item.title: Donald Trump Just Withdrew the U.S. From UN Climate Treaty (and 65 Other Groups)
item.description: Donald Trump has withdrawn the United States from the UN climate treaty. On Wednesday, a memorandum was signed pulling the country out of the deal.

item.title: France Isn’t Just About Surf: A Guide to the Best Lift-Accessed Backcountry in the World
item.description: The author enjoyed an epic, powder-fed trip to Val d’Isère, France, a place he thinks offers the best lift-accessed backcountry in the world. This is his guide.

item.title: There Were Barrels in Los Angeles Last Week
item.description: It doesn't happen often, but when it does, the barrels in Los Angeles can get heavy. And most surfers in the city are out trying to catch a gem.

item.title: Iconic Iceberg Turns Blue and Is ‘On the Verge of Complete Disintegration’
item.description: According to NASA, iceberg A-23A, one of the world's largest, has turned blue as meltwater covers it over. A-23A is "on the verge of complete disintegration."

item.title: Shark Rips Off Minnesota Woman’s Arm in Virgin Islands
item.description: A Minnesota woman has died after losing her arm in an apparent shark attack off the coast of the U.S. Virgin Islands.

item.description: Variety is the spice of life. Mason Ho likes his waves spicy. Hawaii, Australia, Mexico, California, Puerto Rico, Texas, Indonesia are in this 40-minute video.

item.title: Cause of Death Determined for Swimmer Killed off Pacific Grove, California Coast
item.description: A coroner has confirmed the cause of death for a woman who went missing last month at Lovers Point in Pacific Grove, California.

item.title: Unearthed Hawaiian Surf Footage From 1974: Anyone Have a Time Machine We Can Borrow?
item.description: In 1974, Phil Sheppard directed one of the earliest international surf films. It was called "A Winter's Tale" and it shows Hawaiian surf at its finest.
